description.text:
Japan's version of the English EX Power Keepers: the same 108 cards, with Pokémon-ex such as Salamence ex and Metagross ex and the Stadiums of the Hoenn Elite Four. It was made so that Japanese players would not be at a disadvantage at the 2007 World Championships, which is why it came out in July 2007, after two Diamond & Pearl expansions had already started a new era, as the tenth and last expansion of the PCG era.

The first edition was sold by order: players ordered packs of fifteen cards on the Pokémon Card Game website from 15 June to 1 July 2007, and the packs went out from 5 July; they were also available at Summer Battle Road 2007. A later unlimited printing, sold only briefly in spring 2008, is one of the rarest Japanese packs.
